item.title: Timothy Gowers: How worried should we be about extinction risk from AI?
item.description: A Fields medalist works through x-risk layer by layer — wants, misgeneralization, resource competition — after joining MAISI's advisory panel, and finds his old layer-1 dismissals don't survive contact with the rejoinders.

item.title: Terry Tao: SAIR Open Math OS released
item.description: An open, donated-compute alternative to frontier math models — hosting DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Flash, with team accounts where collaborators see each other's prompts, free for academics.

item.title: Geoffrey Huntley: State of agentic coding #11 — labs that can't fail
item.description: Huntley argues lab financials are cooked — ROI must clear a higher bond rate with an adoption curve steeper than humans can deliver — while co-host Armin Ronacher dissents in the same post.

item.title: Matthew Green: Measuring Human Cryptanalysis Effort
item.description: Green used Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra to classify ~16,000 papers into cryptanalyst-hours per public-key assumption — lattices have only recently overtaken elliptic curves.
